reviews.title: AS3 Area 8 FTE, IME, Stage3D, Pixel Bender shaders, and 3D display runtime
reviews.summary: Implements and verifies 578 AS3 declarations across Flash Text Engine (flash.text.engine.*), IME (flash.text.ime.*), Stage3D/Context3D AGAL software rasterizer (flash.display3D.*), Pixel Bender shaders (Shader/ShaderData/ShaderParameter/ShaderInput/ShaderJob/ShaderFilter/GraphicsShaderFill), 3D DisplayObject/Transform, Loader/LoaderInfo, MorphShape, and AVM1Movie.
